items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying, 3:15 Number the children of Levi after the house of their fathers, by their families: every male from a month old and upward shalt thou number them.
items.claim: The text says the LORD told Moses, in the wilderness of Sinai, to count the Levites by their fathers' houses and families. Every male one month old and older was to be counted.
items.object: the children of Levi, every male from a month old and upward
items.mechanism: a count by the house of their fathers and by families
